project.name: WaveeMusic
project.description: A modern, open-source Spotify desktop client for Windows — a clean-room .NET 10 reimplementation of Spotify’s Access Point, Connect, Mercury, and metadata protocols wrapped in a WinUI 3 desktop app, with an out-of-process audio runtime. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the Wavee.Console AOT CLI client, producing a minimal .NET 10 runtime image with dotnet restore, build, and publish stages targeting linux-x64 or linux-arm64.
nodes.languageNotes: Three-stage multi-stage build (build -> publish -> final) using .NET 10 SDK and runtime base images; ENTRYPOINT runs Wavee.Console.dll.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Build stage that restores NuGet dependencies and compiles Wavee.Console using the .NET 10 SDK image.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.summary: Publish stage that runs dotnet publish to produce the final self-contained or framework-dependent output artifacts.

nodes.name: final
nodes.summary: Final runtime stage that copies published artifacts and sets the ENTRYPOINT to run Wavee.Console.dll.

nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that builds Wavee.UI.WinUI as signed MSIX packages for x64 and ARM64 on tag push, using Azure Artifact Signing, and attaches them as artifacts on a draft GitHub Release.
nodes.languageNotes: Matrix strategy runs build-sign job in parallel for x64 and arm64; release job depends on both matrix legs via needs: build-sign and only runs on tag pushes.

nodes.name: build-sign
nodes.summary: CI job that checks out the repo, restores NuGet packages, builds and packages MSIX via MSBuild, signs the package using Azure Trusted Signing, and uploads the signed MSIX as a workflow artifact.

nodes.name: release
nodes.summary: CI job that downloads the signed MSIX artifacts from both matrix legs and creates a draft GitHub Release with auto-generated release notes, triggered only on tag pushes.

nodes.name: composition-image.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive architecture guide covering the CompositionImage GPU-resident image primitive — its LoadedImageSurface lifecycle, ImageCacheService cache behavior, CrossFadeImage, and every XAML/code-behind consumer across the WaveeMusic app.

nodes.name: connect-state.md
nodes.summary: Architecture guide for the Spotify Connect subsystem — covering DealerClient WebSocket, DeviceStateManager PutState announce, PlaybackStateManager cluster state, ConnectCommandClient remote commands, and all related UI surfaces (device picker, now-playing, volume, connect-debug).

nodes.name: content-card.md
nodes.summary: Architecture guide for the ContentCard reusable shelf/grid card control — covering its four partial-class structure, all XAML consumers across Home/Search/Browse/Library/Artist/Album/Show/Concert/Profile/Local pages, lifecycle viewport gating, attached behaviors, and image loading pipeline.

nodes.name: discography-expander.md
nodes.summary: Architecture guide for the artist-page inline album expander — documenting ExpandableAlbumGrid, the custom ExpandingGridLayout virtualizing layout with reserved band, and the AlbumDetailPanel overlay, including its expand/collapse data flow and the pitfalls of earlier abandoned approaches.

nodes.name: library-and-sync.md
nodes.summary: Architecture guide for the user-library lifecycle — collection sync (Liked Songs, Saved Albums, Artists, Shows, Pins, Listen Later, Bans), SQLite persistence via IMetadataDatabase, dealer-driven incremental updates, save/pin/follow write paths, and every library and playlist UI surface.

nodes.name: playback.md
nodes.summary: Architecture guide for the local playback runtime spanning two processes — orchestrator, queue+context, track resolution, AudioHost IPC contract, decode/decrypt/DSP/EQ pipeline, prefetch, crossfade, local-file playback, video playback, SMTC integration, and the UI-side playback service.

nodes.name: queue.md
nodes.summary: Deep-dive architecture guide for the playback queue subsystem — the three-bucket in-memory model (user queue, context, post-context), cursor/shuffle/repeat semantics, pagination signals, autoplay rollover, cluster sync (PutState prev/next + QueueRevision), the QueueControl UI, drag-drop, and SetQueue/AddToQueue dealer commands.

nodes.name: track-and-episode-ui.md
nodes.summary: Architecture guide for every WaveeMusic UI surface that renders a track or podcast episode — covering shared row controls (TrackItem, TrackDataGrid, TrackListView, ShowEpisodeRow), all page-level track/episode lists, queue rows, search results, omnibar suggestions, home episode cards, local-file rows, and now-playing surfaces.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker ignore file listing files and directories to exclude from Docker build context for the WaveeMusic project.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-targeted guide defining the index, authoring conventions, and protocol-isolation invariant for all component guides under .agents/guides/, serving as the single source of truth for how LLM agents should navigate and extend the Wavee codebase documentation.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive LLM-agent instruction file covering architecture, commands, conventions, process model, AI features, testing, and proprietary exclusions — the primary guide for Claude Code working in the WaveeMusic repository.
nodes.languageNotes: 19 sections covering everything from build commands to anti-fraud telemetry mimicry conventions.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project-level overview of WaveeMusic — a clean-room Spotify desktop client for Windows — covering features, project structure, technology stack, gabo telemetry, quick-start instructions, and licensing.

nodes.name: decode_gabo.sh
nodes.summary: Developer diagnostic script that decodes base64-encoded Spotify gabo-receiver-service request bodies using protoc against the event_sender proto schemas to inspect telemetry payloads.
nodes.languageNotes: Shell script using protoc (Grpc.Tools) to decode PublishEventsRequest protobufs; targets Windows x64 protoc binary path.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive guide for signing Wavee MSIX packages with Azure Artifact Signing, covering one-time setup, the manifest publisher-swap rationale, CI integration, LAF token coupling, and SmartScreen reputation notes.

nodes.name: Set-Publisher.ps1
nodes.summary: Standalone PowerShell helper that rewrites the Publisher attribute in Package.appxmanifest from the dev self-signed subject (CN=ckara) to the Azure Artifact Signing certificate profile subject, so SignTool's publisher-match check passes at release build time.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses System.Xml.XmlWriter with UTF-8-BOM encoding to satisfy MSIX tooling's manifest encoding requirements.

nodes.name: Sign-Msix.ps1
nodes.summary: Low-level PowerShell wrapper around SignTool with the Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib plugin; auto-detects the dlib and signtool.exe paths, supports signing a single .msix/.msixbundle or a whole folder, and falls back from SPN env vars to an existing az login session for authentication.
nodes.languageNotes: Searches multiple known install paths for Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib.dll to handle both per-user LOCALAPPDATA and older Program Files layouts.

nodes.name: Sign-Release.ps1
nodes.summary: End-to-end local release pipeline for Wavee: swaps the manifest publisher, runs MSBuild to produce an unsigned MSIX (with specific flags to avoid WMC9999), signs with Azure Artifact Signing dlib, verifies the chain via signtool, optionally installs via Add-AppxPackage, and restores the dev publisher in a try/finally even on Ctrl-C.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately omits /p:RuntimeIdentifier from MSBuild to avoid WMC9999 XAML compiler error; uses try/finally for publisher restore to guarantee working-tree cleanliness.

nodes.name: laf-second-request.md
nodes.summary: Pre-written email draft for requesting a second Microsoft Limited Access Feature token for Phi Silica against the production Artifact Signing publisher, plus step-by-step instructions for integrating the new token into AiCapabilities.cs once received.

nodes.name: metadata.template.json
nodes.summary: Committed template for the gitignored metadata.json consumed by SignTool via the Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib plugin; contains placeholder values for the Azure Artifact Signing endpoint URL, account name, and certificate profile name.

nodes.name: BassDecoder.cs
nodes.summary: IAudioDecoder implementation using the ManagedBass library to decode MP3, AAC, FLAC, and streaming ICY/HTTP audio; supports local files, URL streams, and in-memory buffers.

nodes.name: BassDecoder

nodes.name: GetFormatAsync

nodes.name: EnsureBassInitialized

nodes.name: BassPluginLoader.cs

nodes.name: BassPluginLoader

nodes.name: SkipStream.cs

nodes.name: SkipStream

nodes.name: StubDecoder.cs

nodes.name: StubDecoder

nodes.name: VorbisDecoder.cs

nodes.name: VorbisDecoder

nodes.name: DecodeAsync

nodes.name: TryFindVorbisStartOffset

nodes.name: AudioProcessingChain.cs

nodes.name: AudioProcessingChain

nodes.name: Process

nodes.name: CompressorProcessor.cs

nodes.name: CompressorProcessor

nodes.name: CrossfadeProcessor.cs

nodes.name: CrossfadeProcessor
nodes.summary: Crossfade processor maintaining a state machine (Idle/Crossfading/Done); mixes buffers with curve-driven gain envelopes across PCM-16/24/32 formats using per-format Mix/ApplyGain helpers.

nodes.name: MixBuffers
nodes.summary: Blends current and next track buffers by computing per-buffer fade-out and fade-in gains then dispatching to the PCM-format-specific MixIntXX helper.

nodes.name: EqualizerProcessor.cs

nodes.name: EqualizerProcessor

nodes.name: WaitForVersionProcessedAsync

nodes.name: LimiterProcessor.cs
nodes.summary: IAudioProcessor implementing a per-channel brickwall limiter with configurable ceiling and release time, preventing clipping at the output stage.

nodes.name: LimiterProcessor

nodes.name: NormalizationProcessor.cs

nodes.name: NormalizationProcessor
nodes.summary: Audio processor implementing ReplayGain normalization with configurable modes (Track/Album/Off), pre-amp dB, and soft-clip prevention across multiple PCM bit depths.

nodes.name: SetTrackGain

nodes.name: Process
nodes.summary: Allocates an output buffer and dispatches normalization processing to the appropriate per-bit-depth implementation (Int16/Int24/Int32).

nodes.name: VolumeProcessor.cs

nodes.name: VolumeProcessor

nodes.name: SingleThreadedSynchronizationContext.cs

nodes.name: CircularAudioBuffer

nodes.name: StubAudioSink.cs

nodes.name: IPlugin
nodes.summary: Core interface all Lyricify lyrics plugins must implement: identity metadata, init/dispose lifecycle, and settings-definition retrieval.

nodes.name: IAIService.cs
nodes.summary: Interface for the on-device AI service used by lyrics plugins, abstracting text generation and analysis calls to the underlying AI runtime.

nodes.name: LyricsEngine.cs
nodes.summary: Core rendering engine for the lyrics overlay, orchestrating lyrics layout, background renderers (fluid, spectrum, snow, fog, rain), palette transitions, mouse interaction, and a performance profiler across a 945-line update/draw loop.

nodes.name: LyricsEngine
nodes.summary: Central class managing the full lyrics rendering pipeline: resource creation, per-frame update/draw dispatch, mouse hover state, playback position tracking, background effects, palette management, and Spout/spectrum hooks.

nodes.name: LyricsEngine
nodes.summary: Constructor wiring up renderers, synchronizer, animator, and transition objects that compose the full lyrics canvas.

nodes.name: RefreshHoveringLineIndex
nodes.summary: Recomputes which lyrics line is currently hovered by the mouse, factoring in scroll offset and visible range.

nodes.name: TryRefreshHoveringLine
nodes.summary: Attempts to update the hover highlight line and fires a seek if the user is pressing the mouse button on that line.

nodes.name: CreateResources
nodes.summary: Initializes GPU resources for all sub-renderers and optionally sets up the Spout and spectrum analyzer on resource creation.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Per-frame update processing dirty flags, advancing animations, updating playback state, scrolling the canvas, and triggering a relayout when lyrics data or dimensions change.

nodes.name: Draw
nodes.summary: Per-frame draw call that clears the canvas, delegates to background renderers, and composites the foreground lyrics over them.

nodes.name: DrawCore
nodes.summary: Core drawing pass rendering background, edge feathering, lyrics lines, and optionally a debug overlay.

nodes.name: DrawCoreWithEdgeFeatheringHandled
nodes.summary: Wraps DrawCore with edge-feathering pre/post operations to produce smooth fade-out borders.

nodes.name: DrawDebugOverlay
nodes.summary: Renders an on-canvas performance overlay showing update/draw frame rates and relayout counters for diagnostics.

nodes.name: FinalizePerfSampleIfDue
nodes.summary: Accumulates per-frame timing samples and periodically computes rolling-average frame rates for the debug overlay.

nodes.name: InitSpectrumAnalyzer
nodes.summary: Creates and configures the audio spectrum analyzer used for spectrum-reactive background effects.

nodes.name: UpdateSpectrumCaptureState
nodes.summary: Starts or stops audio spectrum capture depending on whether a spectrum-type background is currently active.

nodes.name: TriggerRelayout
nodes.summary: Recomputes the layout of all visible lyrics lines when playback position, canvas size, or lyrics data changes, updating the primary playing line index and scroll target.

nodes.name: ReloadCoverBackgroundResourcesAsync
nodes.summary: Asynchronously decodes the album art bytes and reloads cover-based background renderer resources including color palette extraction.

nodes.name: DisposeRenderLyricsLines
nodes.summary: Disposes all existing rendered lyrics line objects, reclaiming GPU resources before a full relayout.

nodes.name: UpdatePalette
nodes.summary: Applies a new color palette to the background renderers and starts smooth color transitions for immersive background effects.

nodes.name: Dispose
nodes.summary: Disposes all sub-renderers, the spectrum analyzer, and associated resources, stopping background audio capture.

nodes.name: BoolSettingDef.cs

nodes.name: ChoiceSettingDef.cs

nodes.name: NumberSettingDef.cs

nodes.name: TextSettingDef.cs

nodes.name: FPS.cs

nodes.name: ImageSwitchType.cs

nodes.name: LyricsDisplayType.cs
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing lyrics display modes (e.g., translation only, original only, bilingual) for the rendering engine.

nodes.name: LyricsEffectScope.cs
nodes.summary: Enum for which lyrics lines receive visual effects (all, active-only, etc.) in the animation pipeline.

nodes.name: LyricsFontColorType.cs
nodes.summary: Enum for lyrics font color sourcing strategy (palette-derived, fixed color, accent, etc.).

nodes.name: LyricsFormat.cs
nodes.summary: Enum identifying the input lyrics format (LRC, TTML, plain text, etc.) for the lyrics parser.

nodes.name: LyricsLayoutOrientation.cs
nodes.summary: Enum for lyrics layout orientation (horizontal/vertical) controlling line arrangement direction.

nodes.name: MemoryValueType.cs
nodes.summary: Enum for memory/persistence value categories used in the lyrics settings memory system.

nodes.name: PaletteGeneratorType.cs

nodes.name: DockPlacement.cs

nodes.name: DockPlacementExtensions

nodes.name: ToWindowPixelSampleMode

nodes.name: LyricsFontWeight.cs

nodes.name: LyricsFontWeightExtensions

nodes.name: SpectrumPlacement.cs

nodes.name: SpectrumStyle.cs

nodes.name: TaskbarPlacement.cs

nodes.name: TextAlignmentType.cs

nodes.name: TitleBarArea.cs
nodes.summary: Defines the TitleBarArea enum for identifying drag and non-drag regions of the custom lyrics window title bar.

nodes.name: WindowPixelSampleMode.cs
nodes.summary: Defines the WindowPixelSampleMode enum for controlling background pixel-sampling strategy in the lyrics now-playing canvas.

nodes.name: WindowStatus.cs
nodes.summary: Defines the WindowStatus enum representing the current visibility and focus state of the lyrics overlay window.

nodes.name: WordByWordEffectMode.cs
nodes.summary: Defines the WordByWordEffectMode enum controlling how the word-by-word lyrics highlight animation is applied on the canvas.

nodes.name: AppWindowExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Provides an AppWindow extension method that sets the window icon across the title bar, taskbar, and system decorations in one call.

nodes.name: CanvasTextLayoutExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Extends Win2D CanvasTextLayout with a helper that automatically selects a CJK-appropriate font family based on the text content.

nodes.name: ColorExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Extends Windows.UI.Color with opacity adjustment, HSL-based saturation shifting, and conversion to System.Numerics.Vector3 for composition use.

nodes.name: DisposableObjectExtension.cs

nodes.name: ElementThemeExtensions.cs

nodes.name: EnumExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Provides a generic GetNext extension method on any enum type that cycles to the next value, wrapping around at the end of the defined values.

nodes.name: LyricsDataExtensions.cs

nodes.name: LyricsFormatExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Extends the LyricsFormat enum with a ToDisplayString helper returning a human-readable label for each supported lyrics format.

nodes.name: LyricsLayoutOrientationExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Extends LyricsLayoutOrientation with converters to WinUI FlowDirection and a boolean IsVertical flag, throwing ArgumentOutOfRangeException for unknown values.

nodes.name: PointExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Extends Windows.Foundation.Point with a ToVector2 conversion for Win2D and Composition drawing APIs.

nodes.name: RectExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Provides extensive Windows.Foundation.Rect extension methods for intersection test, containment, center, directional expansion/contraction, corner access, union, and NaN guards.

nodes.name: StringExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Extends string with lyrics-specific utilities: line splitting, CJK/Hiragana/Katakana/Thai/Arabic Unicode range detection, and Spotify artist URI decoding for the now-playing canvas.

nodes.name: ThicknessExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Extends WinUI Thickness with helpers to extract each edge (Left, Right, Top, Bottom) as its own single-sided Thickness value.

nodes.name: VectorExtensions.cs

nodes.name: WindowExtensions.cs
nodes.summary: Extends WinUI Window with SetIsBorderless, which toggles WS_BORDER/WS_DLGFRAME via Win32 User32 SetWindowLong for borderless-window mode in the lyrics overlay.

nodes.name: ColorHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Static helper providing theme detection, accessible foreground color derivation via HSL contrast adjustment, animated color interpolation, and Vector3-to-Color conversion for the now-playing canvas.

nodes.name: EasingHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Generic-numeric (INumber<T>) easing function library with a thread-safe interpolator cache; implements Sine, Quad, Cubic, Quart, Quint, Expo, Circle, Back, Elastic, Bounce, SmoothStep, CubicBezier, and Linear curves used by the lyrics animation engine.

nodes.name: LyricsDataExtensions
nodes.summary: Extension class that normalizes Lyricify LyricsData, aligning translation and transliteration lines to primary lyrics by closest timestamp.

nodes.name: RectExtensions
nodes.summary: Comprehensive geometry extension class for Windows.Foundation.Rect covering intersection, containment, center, expansion, shrink, corner retrieval, and union.

nodes.name: StringExtensions
nodes.summary: String extension class with Unicode script detection (CJK, Hiragana, Katakana, Thai, Arabic) and lyrics-line splitting used by the now-playing canvas renderer.

nodes.name: DisposableObjectExtension
nodes.summary: Reflection-based extension class for checking disposed state on Win2D and WinRT objects that lack a public IsDisposed property.

nodes.name: ColorHelper
nodes.summary: Static color utility providing theme inference, accessible foreground derivation via HSL, animated interpolation, and Vector3 conversion for the lyrics canvas.

nodes.name: EasingHelper
nodes.summary: Generic-numeric static easing class with ConcurrentDictionary-cached interpolator delegates; central animation math provider for the lyrics canvas.

nodes.name: GetForegroundColor
nodes.summary: Computes an accessible foreground color from a background Color by converting to HSL, clamping lightness for contrast, and returning the adjusted color.

nodes.name: BuildAndCacheInterpolator
nodes.summary: Constructs a typed interpolator delegate for the given easing type and mode, storing it in the thread-safe cache for zero-allocation reuse.

nodes.name: Ease
nodes.summary: Mode-aware easing dispatcher that clamps input and handles EaseIn/EaseOut/EaseInOut symmetry by delegating to the supplied easeIn function.

nodes.name: EaseInElastic
nodes.summary: Computes an elastic ease-in curve using exponential decay and sinusoidal oscillation for a spring-overshoot animation effect.

nodes.name: EaseOutBounce
nodes.summary: Implements the bounce ease-out curve with four piecewise polynomial bounce segments of decreasing amplitude.

nodes.name: ImageHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Provides image loading, conversion, noise generation, and album-art palette extraction utilities used by the lyrics rendering canvas.

nodes.name: ImageHelper
nodes.summary: Static helper class with methods for downloading images, converting buffers/streams, generating noise bitmaps, and triggering palette generation.

nodes.name: GetImageByteArrayFromUrlAsync
nodes.summary: Downloads or reads image bytes from a URL, data URL, or local file path with fallback error handling.

nodes.name: DataUrlToByteArray
nodes.summary: Parses a data URL (base64 or plain text) and returns the raw byte array.

nodes.name: GenerateNoiseBGRA
nodes.summary: Generates a random BGRA noise pixel array of the given dimensions.

nodes.name: GetAccentColorsAsync
nodes.summary: Extracts accent colors from a BitmapDecoder using the specified palette generator strategy.

nodes.name: LanguageHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Provides language detection, CJK/Romaji/Pinyin classification, transliteration support, and Chinese character conversion for the lyrics display pipeline.

nodes.name: LanguageHelper
nodes.summary: Static helper class for detecting script systems (CJK, Romaji, Latin), converting Hanzi to Pinyin/Jyutping, and resolving display language names for lyrics.

nodes.name: DetectLanguageCode
nodes.summary: Detects the BCP-47 language code of a text string or collection of lines using transliteration heuristics and a language identifier library.

nodes.name: TryDetectTransliteration
nodes.summary: Heuristically checks whether text is Pinyin or Romaji transliteration using tone-mark regexes.

nodes.name: GetOrderChar
nodes.summary: Returns the uppercase sort character for a string, converting Hanzi to Pinyin initial for CJK ordering.

nodes.name: GetLanguageScriptDisplayName
nodes.summary: Returns a human-readable display name for a BCP-47 language/script tag, with special handling for phonetic codes.

nodes.name: GetDisplayName
nodes.summary: Looks up a localized display name for a known language code via the localization service.

nodes.name: LatestOnlyTaskRunner.cs
nodes.summary: Provides a debounce-style async task runner that cancels any pending operation when a new one is submitted, ensuring only the latest task completes.

nodes.name: LatestOnlyTaskRunner
nodes.summary: Cancels the previous CancellationTokenSource and runs the latest provided async action, preventing stale async operations from completing.

nodes.name: RunAsync
nodes.summary: Cancels any in-flight async action and starts the new one with a fresh CancellationToken under a lock.

nodes.name: LyricsAnimator.cs
nodes.summary: Drives per-frame animation of lyrics render lines by computing target opacity, scale, blur, color, angle, and Y-offset transitions for each visible line and character.

nodes.name: LyricsAnimator
nodes.summary: Per-frame animator that applies ValueTransition updates for scale, blur, opacity, fill/stroke color, angle, and floating char effects to lyrics render lines based on playback position and scroll state.

nodes.name: UpdateLines
nodes.summary: Core per-frame update: iterates visible lines and characters, computing and starting all ValueTransition targets based on playing state and elapsed time.

nodes.name: CalculateTargetOpacity
nodes.summary: Calculates target opacity for a lyrics line based on distance from playing line, mouse scroll state, and lyrics effect style.

nodes.name: LyricsLayoutHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Calculates responsive lyrics layout metrics (font sizes for primary, phonetic, translation, transliteration lines) from canvas dimensions.

nodes.name: LyricsLayoutHelper
nodes.summary: Static helper that computes base font size from canvas width/height and derives per-role font sizes using constant ratio multipliers.

nodes.name: CalculateLayout
nodes.summary: Returns a LyricsLayoutMetrics record with all derived font sizes by applying ratio constants to the computed base font size.

nodes.name: CalculateBaseFontSize
nodes.summary: Derives base font size from canvas dimensions using visible-lines target and width-padding heuristics, clamped to min/max bounds.

nodes.name: LyricsLayoutManager.cs
nodes.summary: Manages measure-and-arrange, scroll offset calculation, visible range determination, and mouse-hover hit-testing for the lyrics canvas render lines.

nodes.name: LyricsLayoutManager
nodes.summary: Stateless manager providing MeasureAndArrange, scroll target calculation, visible range detection, lane calculation, and mouse-hover line index resolution for the lyrics canvas.

nodes.name: MeasureAndArrange
nodes.summary: Re-measures text layouts and arranges render lines on the canvas, computing top-left/bottom-right positions for primary and phonetic text blocks.

nodes.name: CalculateTargetScrollOffset
nodes.summary: Computes the Y scroll offset that centers the playing line at the configured offset factor.

nodes.name: CalculateVisibleRange
nodes.summary: Returns the first and last visible line indices given the current scroll offset and canvas dimensions.

nodes.name: CalculateLanes
nodes.summary: Groups lyrics lines into simultaneous display lanes based on overlapping time ranges with a tolerance window.

nodes.name: FindMouseHoverLineIndex
nodes.summary: Returns the index of the lyrics line under the mouse pointer given current scroll offset and canvas geometry.

nodes.name: LyricsSynchronizer.cs
nodes.summary: Efficiently tracks the currently active lyrics line index for a given playback position using a cached last-found index for O(1) common case.

nodes.name: LyricsSynchronizer
nodes.summary: Stateful synchronizer that maintains _lastFoundIndex to skip linear scans when playback advances sequentially through lines.

nodes.name: GetCurrentLineIndex
nodes.summary: Returns the line index active at the given playback time, using a cached index to skip forward or backward only as far as needed.

nodes.name: PaletteHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Routes album-art palette extraction requests to the appropriate generator (OctTree, KMeans, MedianCut, Auto) and provides pixel color dictionary extraction from BitmapDecoder.

nodes.name: PaletteHelper
nodes.summary: Facade delegating to OctTreePaletteGenerator, KMeansPaletteGenerator, or ColorThief for accent color extraction, with a shared GetPixelColorAsync helper.

nodes.name: GetPixelColorAsync
nodes.summary: Extracts a frequency-weighted pixel color dictionary from a BitmapDecoder by sampling BGRA pixel data.

nodes.name: PathHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Exposes static file-system path constants for the language profile, album art placeholder, and logo assets used by the lyrics control.

nodes.name: PathHelper
nodes.summary: Static class with pre-computed asset path properties derived from the assembly base directory.

nodes.name: SpectrumAnalyzer.cs
nodes.summary: Captures system audio via WASAPI loopback and produces a smoothed per-bar FFT spectrum and bass-energy signal for real-time lyrics visualizations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses NAudio WasapiLoopbackCapture and FastFourierTransform; implements IMMNotificationClient to re-capture on default audio device changes.

nodes.name: SpectrumAnalyzer
nodes.summary: Real-time analyzer that loopback-captures stereo WASAPI audio, applies Hamming windowing and FFT, log-maps to BarCount bars with perceptual compensation, and exposes SmoothSpectrum and CurrentBassEnergy.

nodes.name: StartCapture
nodes.summary: Initialises a new WasapiLoopbackCapture for the current default audio device and starts recording.

nodes.name: StopCapture
nodes.summary: Detaches event handlers, stops recording, and disposes the capture instance.

nodes.name: OnDataAvailable
nodes.summary: Core audio callback: deinterleaves stereo floats, applies Hamming window, runs FFT, maps bins to log-spaced bars, updates SmoothSpectrum and CurrentBassEnergy.

nodes.name: UpdateSmoothSpectrum
nodes.summary: Smooths _fullSpectrumData into SmoothSpectrum using configurable attack/decay factors.

nodes.name: OnDefaultDeviceChanged
nodes.summary: Handles WASAPI device change by stopping and restarting capture on the new default device after a brief delay.

nodes.name: StringHelper.cs
nodes.summary: Provides string normalization and switchable-match helpers for lyrics search and comparison.

nodes.name: StringHelper
nodes.summary: Static class with Normalize (strip non-alphanumeric + lowercase) and IsSwitchableNormalizedMatch (bidirectional normalized substring check).

nodes.name: ValueTransition.cs
nodes.summary: Generic keyframe-driven value interpolation engine powering all per-frame animated properties (opacity, scale, blur, Y-offset, color) in the lyrics canvas.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic class parameterised on T; supports queued keyframe sequences, configurable easing, SetDuration/SetDelay/SetInterpolator fluent API, and JumpTo for instant value change.

nodes.name: ValueTransition
nodes.summary: Generic value transition with a keyframe queue, configurable easing interpolator, duration/delay settings, and per-frame Update that advances progress and invokes the interpolator.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Advances the transition by elapsedTime, moves to the next keyframe segment when complete, and writes the interpolated value.

nodes.name: MoveToNextSegment
nodes.summary: Dequeues the next keyframe and resets start/target/progress for the upcoming interpolation segment.

nodes.name: GetInterpolatorByEasingType
nodes.summary: Factory returning a typed interpolator delegate for a given EasingType and EasingMode.

nodes.name: SpoutTextureHook.cs
nodes.summary: Integrates Spout GPU texture sharing into the lyrics canvas by initialising a SpoutSender and forwarding Win2D render targets as Direct3D 11 textures.

nodes.name: SpoutTextureHook
nodes.summary: Disposable hook that wraps a SpoutSender, extracting the ID3D11Device and ID3D11Texture2D from Win2D ICanvasDevice/RenderTarget via DXGI interface access.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Retrieves the underlying ID3D11Device from a Win2D ICanvasDevice and creates the SpoutSender for the given sender name.

nodes.name: SendTexture
nodes.summary: Retrieves the ID3D11Texture2D from a Win2D render target and sends it via the Spout sender.

nodes.name: AutoPaletteGenerator.cs

nodes.name: AutoPaletteGenerator
nodes.summary: Static class that runs both KMeans and OctTree palette generators and picks the result with greater inter-cluster variance in CIELAB space.

nodes.name: CreatePalette
nodes.summary: Runs KMeans and OctTree palette generators, converts results to LAB, computes cluster variance, and returns the better palette.

nodes.name: ColorUtilities.cs
nodes.summary: Implements color space conversion extension methods (RGB-HSV, RGB-XYZ, XYZ-LAB, RGB-LAB) and perceptual luminance helpers used by palette generators.

nodes.name: ColorUtilities
nodes.summary: Static extension class providing bidirectional RGB/HSV, RGB/XYZ, XYZ/CIELAB conversions and luminance dark-mode helpers.

nodes.name: RGBVectorToHSVColor
nodes.summary: Converts an RGB Vector3 (0-255 range) to an HSVColor struct.

nodes.name: RGBVectorToLABVector
nodes.summary: Chains RGB to XYZ to CIELAB conversion into a single extension method.

nodes.name: RGBVectorLStarIsDark
nodes.summary: Returns true when the perceptual luminance L* of the RGB color is below 50%.

nodes.name: XYZVectorToLABVector
nodes.summary: Converts an XYZ tristimulus Vector3 to CIELAB (L*, a*, b*) under D65 illuminant.

nodes.name: KMeansPaletteGenerator.cs
nodes.summary: Implements K-Means and K-Means++ clustering on LAB-space pixel color dictionaries to produce dominant palette and theme color results.

nodes.name: KMeansPaletteGenerator
nodes.summary: Static class providing KMeansCluster and KMeansPlusPlusCluster algorithms over LAB-space color dictionaries, plus CreatePaletteAsync splitting colors by luminance before clustering.

nodes.name: CreatePaletteAsync
nodes.summary: Partitions source colors by dark/light luminance, runs K-Means clustering in LAB space, and returns PaletteResult lists for both buckets.

nodes.name: KMeansCluster
nodes.summary: Iterative K-Means clustering of LAB-space color vectors with random or K-Means++ seeding.

nodes.name: KMeansPlusPlusCluster

nodes.name: OctTreePaletteGenerator.cs

nodes.name: OctTreePaletteGenerator

nodes.name: CreatePaletteAsync
nodes.summary: Quantizes pixel colors by dark/light split using the octree, then retrieves top-N dominant colors for both palette and theme results.

nodes.name: PaletteGenerators.cs
nodes.summary: Constant class exposing palette generator type identifiers (KMeans, OctTree) referenced by PaletteHelper dispatch logic.

nodes.name: PaletteGenerators
nodes.summary: Static class with string constants for the two supported palette generator type keys.

nodes.name: ExtendedLanguage.cs

nodes.name: ExtendedLanguage

nodes.name: Keyframe.cs

nodes.name: LinePlaybackState.cs

nodes.name: BaseLyrics.cs

nodes.name: BaseLyrics

nodes.name: LineTransitions.cs

nodes.name: LyricsData.cs

nodes.name: LyricsData

nodes.name: ILocalLikeService.cs

nodes.name: ILocalLikeService
nodes.summary: Interface for checking, setting, and enumerating liked local track URIs, plus a reactive Changes observable for consumers that need live updates.

nodes.name: LocalEntityKind.cs

nodes.name: LocalFileMetadata.cs

layers.name: Core Protocol Library
layers.description: Spotify protocol implementation including Access Point TCP/TLS session, Dealer WebSocket, Mercury pub/sub, Pathfinder GraphQL, SpClient HTTPS, Connect cluster state, audio key management, OAuth, telemetry (gabo), and all protobuf-generated schema files.

layers.name: UI Service Layer
layers.description: Framework-neutral UI service layer (Wavee.UI) containing view models, library sync logic, DTOs, and domain services that can be tested without WinUI dependencies.

layers.name: Desktop App (WinUI 3)
layers.description: WinUI 3 application layer with Views, ViewModels, Controls, Styles, Behaviors, Helpers, and platform services that compose the full Spotify desktop client UI on Windows.

layers.name: Audio Runtime
layers.description: Out-of-process x64 audio host (Wavee.AudioHost) responsible for decode/decrypt/DSP/EQ pipeline, PlayPlay key derivation via native Spotify.dll, and named-pipe IPC with the UI process.

layers.name: Local Media Library
layers.description: Local file scanning, metadata extraction, SQLite persistence, and playback integration for locally-stored audio files (Wavee.Local).

layers.name: Lyrics Rendering Library
layers.description: Standalone WinUI control library (Wavee.Controls.Lyrics) that renders synchronized lyrics, NowPlaying canvas animations, and on-device AI lyrics features (Phi Silica).

layers.name: IPC Contracts
layers.description: Shared named-pipe IPC message definitions (Wavee.Playback.Contracts) consumed as a project reference by the UI and source-included by AudioHost to avoid cross-process assembly identity issues.

layers.name: Console Client
layers.description: AOT-compiled CLI client (Wavee.Console) and its Dockerfile for Linux/Docker deployment, providing a headless Spotify session and playback entry point.

layers.name: Vendored Libraries
layers.description: Third-party libraries vendored directly into the repository: NVorbis (Ogg/Vorbis decoder) and Lyricify.Lyrics.Helper (lyrics format parsing), both included as project references with full source.

layers.name: Tests
layers.description: All test projects: Wavee.Tests (core protocol xUnit suite), Wavee.UI.Tests (UI service layer), Wavee.Local.Tests (local media), and Wavee.PlayPlay.Tests (x64 PlayPlay key emulator harness).

layers.description: Repository-level configuration (solution files, .slnx/.slnf), CI/CD GitHub Actions workflows, code-signing certificates and scripts, agent/documentation guides, HTML prototypes, and root documentation files.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md and CLAUDE.md to understand what WaveeMusic is and the conventions that govern every corner of the codebase. README covers the Spotify protocol re-implementation (Access Point, Connect, Mercury, Pathfinder), the dual-process architecture, and feature scope. CLAUDE.md layers on agent guides, critical MSBuild quirks, testing matrix, and conventions like FluentGlyphs and pure ServerGC — essential context before touching any code.

tour.title: Solution Structure & Layering
tour.description: The solution file plus the per-project READMEs reveal the deliberate layer cake: Wavee (core protocol, AOT-compatible), Wavee.UI (framework-neutral MVVM), Wavee.UI.WinUI (desktop shell), Wavee.AudioHost (out-of-process x64 audio), Wavee.Playback.Contracts (IPC wire format shared as source, not a project reference). Reading these READMEs before diving into code files prevents surprises about intentional constraints — no WinUI refs in Wavee.UI, no Wavee* refs in AudioHost, strict IL2xxx/IL3xxx-as-errors in the core.
tour.languageLesson: C# solution files (.slnx is the new SDK-style format) list projects and their build configurations. The project layering here is enforced by reference direction: Wavee.UI.WinUI references Wavee.UI which references Wavee — but never vice versa.

tour.title: Desktop App Entry & DI Bootstrap
tour.description: App.xaml.cs is the WinUI entry point, but the real work happens in AppLifecycleHelper which builds an IHost (Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting), wires CommunityToolkit MVVM IoC to the same container, runs schema migrations, starts CacheCleanupService, and activates MainWindow. ShellPage.xaml.cs takes over from there: custom title-bar drag regions, browser-style tab navigation, sidebar wiring, and the nav-cache that keeps GPU surfaces alive across page switches.
tour.languageLesson: WinUI 3 apps use Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting for DI just like ASP.NET Core. The pattern is: build IHost in App.OnLaunched → resolve services via Ioc.Default (CommunityToolkit MVVM) — this decouples ViewModels from the platform, making the Wavee.UI layer testable without WinUI.

tour.title: Core Protocol — Session Anchor
tour.description: Session.cs is the single anchor for everything: AP TCP+TLS connect, authenticate with Spotify's custom Shannon-cipher handshake, then lazy-init every subsystem on first access. A consumer only needing search never opens a Dealer WebSocket or audio key channel. The accompanying ISession.cs interface is what the WinUI app registers in DI — Session is the concrete singleton that wires SessionConfig, IHttpClientFactory, ILogger, and an optional IRemoteStateRecorder. Every other protocol component flows from here.
tour.languageLesson: Lazy initialization with System.Reactive (IObservable<T>) is used throughout the session layer. Subsystems expose observables so consumers can react to state changes without polling — a key pattern that shows up again in DealerClient, PlaybackStateManager, and throughout the UI layer.

tour.title: Spotify Connect & Dealer WebSocket
tour.description: DealerClient manages the persistent Dealer WebSocket — heartbeat, reconnection, message dispatch as IObservable<DealerMessage>. DeviceStateManager announces this device to Spotify Connect and handles PutState (volume, capabilities, cluster announcements). PlaybackStateManager is the reactive bridge between remote cluster state updates and local playback state, handling transfer, queue sync, and QueueRevision. The DEALER_PROTOCOL.md alongside this code is the wire-level reference extracted from protocol analysis.

tour.title: Out-of-Process Audio Runtime
tour.description: AudioHost runs as a separate x64 process because it LoadLibrary's a native audio support pack (PlayPlay key derivation) and uses BASS for audio decode/DSP/EQ. AudioHostService.cs reads IPC commands from the named pipe, dispatches them, and streams events back. IpcMessages.cs in Wavee.Playback.Contracts is the shared wire format — consumed as a project reference by the UI side and as raw source inclusion by AudioHost to prevent any stale DLL mismatch. AudioPipelineProxy.cs on the session side is the client that serializes every playback command across the pipe.
tour.languageLesson: The IPC protocol is length-prefixed JSON over a named pipe: [4 bytes big-endian length][UTF-8 JSON]. This deliberately avoids binary serialization so type identity across two separately-compiled assemblies never matters — any IpcMessage shape change in IpcMessages.cs is automatically picked up by both sides at next build.

tour.title: Playback Orchestration & Queue
tour.description: PlaybackOrchestrator.cs is the high-level conductor: it selects between Spotify audio, local-file, and music-video playback modes, drives the queue, and issues IPC commands to AudioHost. PlaybackQueue.cs implements the three-bucket model (user queue, context tracks, post-context) with cursor navigation, shuffle, repeat, and the NeedsMoreTracks pagination signal. TrackResolver.cs sits below both — it resolves Spotify URIs to streamable assets by fetching protobuf metadata, decrypting audio keys, and selecting quality.

tour.title: Metadata Storage Layer
tour.description: MetadataDatabase.cs is the highest fan-out node in the entire graph (186 outbound edges) — it is the SQLite-backed store for every entity type (tracks, albums, artists, playlists, episodes, shows). It powers library sync, playlist cache, and offline metadata across all views. The cache abstractions (IMetadataDatabase, IEntityCacheService, IHotCache) are defined in the storage abstractions folder and enable the framework-neutral Wavee.UI layer to work with cached data without touching WinUI.
tour.languageLesson: SQLite with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode is the persistence layer. The outbox pattern (OutboxProcessor, IOutboxHandler) decouples write operations from the network: library saves/removes are enqueued as outbox entries and dispatched asynchronously, ensuring UI remains responsive even on flaky connections.

tour.title: Reusable Card Controls
tour.description: ContentCard and BaselineHomeCard are the two highest-traffic card controls in the UI, appearing across Home, Search, Browse, Library, Artist, and Album surfaces. ContentCard.xaml.cs manages viewport-gated image loading and release — images are nulled on unload (intentional) and re-triggered on re-realization. BaselineHomeCard.xaml.cs adds hover preview-audio, playback highlighting, and hero image animations. The content-card agent guide documents every mode, behavior attachment point, and known pitfalls.

tour.title: Track & Episode Row UI
tour.description: TrackItem.xaml.cs is the universal track/episode row: it holds dependency properties, a constructor, and track data initialization. TrackBehavior.cs attaches tap, double-tap, right-tap, pointer-hover, and drag via a single attached property — keeping interaction logic out of the XAML hierarchy. This behavior pattern is the approved way to add track interactions anywhere in the app; duplicating TrackItem or writing bespoke click handlers is explicitly disallowed. The track-and-episode-ui agent guide is the canonical reference.
tour.languageLesson: WinUI 3 attached behaviors (Microsoft.Xaml.Interactivity.Behavior<T>) encapsulate interaction logic into reusable, composable units that attach to any FrameworkElement without subclassing. This is the recommended alternative to code-behind event handlers for complex gesture handling.

tour.title: Lyrics Rendering Engine
tour.description: LyricsEngine.cs orchestrates the GPU-accelerated lyrics overlay: layout computation, background blur, line-by-line animation timing, and CJK romanization. NowPlayingCanvas.xaml.cs is the Win2D CanvasAnimatedControl that drives the GPU render loop — every frame is composited on the GPU rather than composited by XAML. The on-device AI path (Phi Silica, Copilot+ only, opt-in) is wired into the lyrics stack for line explanation and song summarization.
tour.languageLesson: Win2D (Windows 2D Graphics) provides a CanvasAnimatedControl with a hardware-accelerated game-loop-style draw callback. Rendering lyrics here instead of via XAML VisualStateManager transitions eliminates the per-frame element-tree walk cost, enabling smooth 60fps animations even with complex per-word timing.

tour.title: Telemetry — Gabo Events
tour.description: GaboEnvelopeFactory.cs builds the gabo EventEnvelope protos Spotify requires to credit play history, Recently Played, and play counts. The context block must mirror the C++ desktop client exactly (SDK strings, app version 1.2.88.483, real BIOS manufacturer/model, Windows machine SID) — Spotify's anti-fraud pipeline silently drops batches whose context doesn't look first-party. EventService.cs batches IPlaybackEvent instances and posts them to spclient.wg.spotify.com/gabo-receiver-service/v3/events/. This is the sole path that makes plays appear in Recently Played.

tour.title: Protobuf Wire Schemas
tour.description: The Protocol/Protos directory contains the full set of .proto files that define Spotify's internal binary protocol: authentication, Connect cluster state, queue, transfer, playlist mutations, media metadata, and the login5 OAuth flow. These are compiled at build time by Grpc.Tools and the generated files land in Protocol/Generated/. Understanding the schema hierarchy here — connect.proto for cluster state, player.proto for playback, playlist4_external.proto for playlist mutations — is essential when debugging protocol-level issues.
tour.languageLesson: Protobuf field numbers are permanent — once a field number is assigned in a .proto file, it must never be reused even after the field is removed. Backward compatibility relies on adding only optional fields. In Grpc.Tools builds, setting Access='Public' ensures generated classes are accessible across project boundaries without additional wrappers.

tour.title: Build, Packaging & CI/CD
tour.description: Wavee.UI.WinUI.csproj contains several custom MSBuild targets that are critical to understand before modifying the build: BuildAudioHost spawns an isolated dotnet build for AudioHost with Platform=x64 forced (prevents arch contamination); RemoveDuplicateReferencedProjectAssets removes ~14.6 MB of packaging duplicates; and Windows AI projection assembly workarounds handle a WinAppSDK 2.0.1 regression. The release.yml GitHub Actions workflow builds signed MSIX packages for both x64 and ARM64.
tour.languageLesson: MSIX (Microsoft Installer XML) is Windows' modern app packaging format used by WinUI 3 apps. It supports delta updates, clean uninstall, and Store distribution. Code signing via a PFN-bound certificate is required for side-loading outside the Store — the release workflow automates certificate selection and signtool invocation.
